visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A round spinner board with four sectors, a pointer, a chance scale at the front, and a small trial bar chart. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / slate-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not gamey, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Spinner board: warm paper disc (roughness ~0.5). Sectors: four desaturated color wedges with ink numbers. Pointer: a slim warm-grey needle rotating. Scale bar: soft warm-grey rail reading 0 to 1 with a count marker that slides. Trial chart: a small bar chart rack beside the board. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: probability on a 0-1 scale — a 4-sector spinner; the chance of any outcome (1/4) sits at 0.25 on a scale; trials fill a chart and confirm the theory.

GEOMETRY: A round spinner board with four equal sectors numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 and a central needle. At the front, a horizontal scale bar from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain) with a marker that rests at 0.25; popping out a second label shows 0.5. 'Spin' rotates the needle and stops with a tick; 'spin 40' runs 40 quick trials while a small bar chart fills and the scale's marker revisits the landing. A slow mode speaks to the needle one spin at a time.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) spinner board; (2) sectors + needle; (3) scale bar; (4) trial chart.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front, slightly above, frames spinner and scale together; labels legible. Budget 7-11k triangles. Named nodes: SpinnerBoard, Sectors, Needle, ScaleBar, ScaleMarker, TrialChart, Spin40Button. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
